policy.baseline_control: original SHARP_DROP first observed + structural priority + EOD
policy.after_3pct: keep floor +3% permanently (no 5%/7% etc); allow original SHARP_DROP and original STRUCTURAL EXIT only at causally observed, post-activation checkpoints; no retroactive old intent
policy.before_3pct: no old SHARP_DROP or STRUCTURAL exit signal; only new profit floor/stop and EOD
policy.trigger_unit: hypothetical net cash return after frozen BUY and SELL multipliers, measured on bar OHLC
policy.observation: completed valid one-minute OHLC only; OHLC of minute m is known at m+1; newly reached profit floors are armed AFTER that bar and only enforceable on later completed bars; already active floors checked before arming higher ones
policy.fill: next legal existing session raw source at or after trigger minute, SELL price raw Open *0.9995; no instantaneous checkpoint-price fill
policy.unknown_intrabar: if previous floor and new High both touched on same bar, old floor breach wins; ambiguous no oracle order
policy.old_state_traces: if frozen V3 trace stops at former SELL intent and +3 arm requires later old EXIT State, mark UNVERIFIED_LEGACY_POST_OLD_INTENT; NEVER fabricate successful legacy coverage

volatility_provisional.metric: median ((H-L)/C) over up to 20 most recent valid and fully completed pre-Entry same-session raw 1-min bars, excluding open-mixed bars
volatility_provisional.threshold: median of metric across 2025-06-27 through 2025-07-10 Entry universe with >=5 valid prefix bars, computed without EXIT labels
volatility_provisional.low_support: if only 1..4 valid bars, use available bars with LOW_SUPPORT flag; zero bars => BLOCKED
